## Status

Galaxy is an optional conceptual mapping unless the instructor confirms a tested server and tool versions.

## Workflow mapping

```text
FastQC -> Galaxy FastQC
trimming -> fastp or cutadapt
mapping -> Bowtie2
counting -> featureCounts
peak calling -> MACS2 or MACS3
tracks -> deepTools, if available
```

Record server URL, tool versions, and parameters if used.
